notes.title: Hotfix 2.0.1
notes.content:
[Patch note]

1. Improved memory (RAM) optimization

2. Warning that 'This game may contain inappropriate content for some players' at the start of the game

3. Change the position of the quick menu overlapped with the mobile phone UI to the lower left (appears immediately when mouse is hovered)

4. Change the shortcut to show 'Key Description' from  to 

5. Some lines and directing modifications

notes.content:

(However, when the same person continues to speak, the previous words may be cut off.)
